title: finance.petty_cash.transferred, schema_version 1
description: A petty cash box a product kept is moved into a Finance petty cash fund, which keeps it from then on. Finance opens a petty cash account for it, sets up the fund at the same float with no custodian until a manager names one after counting the cash, and moves what the box held out of Cash (where the product's till events had put it): Dr the new account / Cr cash. Sent once per box. Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit; another currency than the books' is converted at Finance's rate for the day.

reference.description: The product's own id for the box.

float_minor.description: The amount the box was kept at.

held_minor.description: What the box held when it was moved, by the product's records.

custodian.description: Who kept it in the product, for the record; Finance names its own custodian.
